add.title: Trans Rights in Mexico: Progress and Challenges | Human Rights Watch
add.summary: HRW's state-by-state map of transgender rights in Mexico shows Veracruz was among the last states to legislate: only in 2025 did its congress reform the Civil Code to create an administrative procedure for legal gender recognition, with no age requirement. The page documents no prison-placement rule for Veracruz and no information on where trans prisoners are housed; its Veracruz content concerns identity documents (civil registry) only.
